title: Enchanted Brew: Magical Plant Shader Laboratory
description: A coffee mug sits on a desk emitting mystical steam particles. A translucent plant grows beside it, reacting to custom shaders the user controls. The user adjusts shader parameters like fresnel intensity, chromatic aberration, dissolve threshold, pulsation speed, and color palette to transform both objects into a unified magical diorama.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb and coffeeMug.glb using GLTFLoader. Position the coffee mug at center on a subtle circular platform and the plant slightly behind and to the right, as if growing from the desk. Camera starts at (0, 1.5, 3) looking at origin. Use OrbitControls for rotation. Add a warm directional light and soft ambient light.

Replace materials on BOTH models with custom ShaderMaterial instances. The mug shader should include: (1) a fresnel rim glow effect with user-controllable intensity (0-3), (2) a animated vertical dissolve effect with adjustable threshold (0-1) that reveals a glowing inner energy texture using procedural noise. The plant shader should include: (3) a chromatic aberration transmission effect with adjustable strength (0-0.05), (4) a pulsation animation that oscillates vertex positions along normals with controllable speed (0-5), and (5) a color palette shift uniform that blends between three preset magical palettes (emerald-gold, violet-cyan, crimson-amber) via a slider (0-2).

Create a dat.gui panel with these 5 parameters. Each parameter must update the corresponding shader uniform in real-time. Add a sixth control: a 'Link Aura' toggle button that, when enabled, spawns animated particle lines (using BufferGeometry with Lines) connecting the mug rim to the plant leaves, colored by the active palette. The vertex shader for particles should animate positions using sin waves over time.

All shaders must pass uniforms for uTime (updated each frame), plus the respective control uniforms. The dissolve shader should use a smoothstep on a procedural noise function comparing against the threshold. The fresnel calculation should use dot(viewDirection, normal). Validate that all 6 interactions produce visible changes. The scene background should be a dark gradient created via a simple background shader on a fullscreen quad or set scene.background to a dark color. Ensure the platform beneath uses a reflective MeshStandardMaterial with roughness 0.15.
